title: Nullity of coordinate thresholds
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$ and $t\in\mathbb R$. For the probability measure on the plane obtained by taking independent standard Gaussian variables $U,V$ and mapping them to $(U,\rho U+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,V)$, the set where either coordinate equals $t$ has measure zero.
